name: Sacchan no Daibouken
source:
Main hero hears a rumor that Kojima Sachi (Sacchan) loves 500 yen coins. To get close to her he needs to get a rare coin. Then he discovers that Ayako and her lesbian partner have one and the hunt for the coin begins.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1988.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公听说小岛幸（小幸）最喜欢500日元硬币。为了接近她，他必须弄到一枚稀有硬币。随后，他发现绫子和她的女同性恋伴侣手中正好有一枚，一场硬币争夺战就此展开。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1988.html]vndbreview[/url]]
